notes: L-shaped long tray: web 1/2 + flange 3/4 with two end walls 5/8 and 6/7 folded up from the web; each end wall has an outward top lip (9/12, 10/11) and a short inner weld-lap tab (13/15, 14/16) folded from the end wall towards the flange. End wall to flange corners are welded seams (two sheet edges), not bends.

bends.note: web to flange, 90 deg, full length
end wall 5/8 to top lip 9/12, 90 deg
end wall 6/7 to top lip 10/11, 90 deg
end wall 5/8 to weld-lap tab 13/15 (formed, between reliefs), 90 deg; extent set to the tab width between reliefs (auto clipped by sparse outer-skin patch 15)
end wall 6/7 to weld-lap tab 14/16 (formed, between reliefs), 90 deg; extent set to the tab width between reliefs (auto clipped by sparse outer-skin patch 16)
